title: Perfect binary tree: every level is completely filled
summary: In a perfect binary tree every level is full and all leaves are on the bottom level.
description: The nodes in the four-level tree on the left have no value labels. Their number doubles each level: 1 root on the first level, 2 nodes on the second, 4 on the third, and 8 leaves on the fourth. The gray note below reads “Every level is completely filled.”
Every internal node has both a left and a right child. All 8 leaves line up on the bottom, fourth level. The title on the right reads “Perfect binary tree.”

frames.title: Perfect binary tree: every level is completely filled
frames.explanation: Counting gives four levels, 15 nodes, and a height of 3 edges. In general a perfect binary tree of height h has 2 to the power (h+1), minus 1, nodes.
